scope: Complete selected ordinary proofs, claim-critical supporting arguments, witnesses, exact finite certificates and historical literal data. Private source locations/revisions and operational histories are excluded.
omissions: Full third-party articles/ZIPs, operational reviews/logs, redundant discovery census launchers, native binaries/caches and transient intermediates are omitted. Public independent checkers, literal census ledgers and exact witnesses support the stated reproduction scope.
authored_material: New report, navigation/guides, driver and publication receipts are authored continuation material. The builder adapts existing public Pandoc/Tectonic conventions; manuscript.md is canonical. Root FILES.sha256 covers all current artifacts; this manifest excludes itself and current release inventories to avoid cycles.
